# Rating

Choose, change, or clear one score on an ordered rating scale.

## Usage

### Five star

Choose and clear a score on a five-point rating scale.

<ComponentExample component="rating" scenario="five-star" title="Five star" description="Choose and clear a score on a five-point rating scale." :index="0" />

### Required

Require one value to remain selected or one section to remain expanded.

<ComponentExample component="rating" scenario="required" title="Required" description="Require one value to remain selected or one section to remain expanded." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="rating" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Selection-state motion example

Selection is exposed through public ARIA or state attributes. A short color/scale transition confirms the result while remaining independent from keyboard navigation.

```css
[data-scope='rating'][data-part='item'] {
  transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease;
}

[data-scope='rating'][data-part='item'][aria-checked='true'] {
  transform: scale(1.025);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='rating'][data-part='item'] {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

Rating choices use radio-group semantics, keep every score named, and provide an explicit clear action.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/radio/) for the host accessibility contract.
